definitions.explanation: becoming slower, less active, or less vigorous, typically used for economic indicators or rates of change

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}→経済成長：20453_keizaiseichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍化|どんか}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鈍化|どんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{懸念|けねん}される→懸念する：22508_kenensuru⟧。
examples.english: There are concerns about economic slowdown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伸|の}び→伸び：19827_nobi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍化|どんか}してきた。
examples.english: Sales growth has started to decelerate.

examples.japanese: ⟦インフレ→インフレ：04848_infure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鈍化|どんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Interest rates may fall due to the slowdown in inflation.

notes:
{鈍化|どんか} refers to the process of becoming slower or less vigorous, primarily used in economic and business contexts.

WRITING:
- {鈍|どん} (dull, blunt, slow)
- ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (-ification, becoming)

USAGE:
- {鈍化|どんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to slow down, to decelerate - suru verb)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鈍化|どんか} (slowdown of ~)

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}→経済成長：20453_keizaiseichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鈍化|どんか} (economic growth slowdown)
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鈍化|どんか} (economic slowdown)
- ⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鈍化|どんか} (consumption slowdown)
- ⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鈍化|どんか} (demand deceleration)
- ⟦インフレ→インフレ：04848_infure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鈍化|どんか} (inflation slowdown)

REGISTER:
- Formal/technical
- Common in economic news, business reports, and financial analysis

- ⟦{停滞|ていたい}→停滞：07427_teitai⟧ (stagnation) - more severe than {鈍化|どんか}
